scope: step5 development evidence; independent read-only audit, not step6/7 formal scoring
checks: At least two distinct candidate geometries with original initial geometry retained; exactly C6H14, same ordered elements; independently inspect connectivity when library supports it.

Every energy used for ranking comes from its own archived ORCA stdout FINAL SINGLE POINT ENERGY, with normal termination and SCF convergence; compare actual method, basis, charge, multiplicity, state and gas phase across candidates.
Rank energies in ascending order; recompute differences against lowest observed member, check stated units/formula. Tolerance: 5e-9 Eh or 5e-5 kJ/mol for tabulated rounding.
All generated candidates, failed members, excluded members and exclusion reasons are retained in task files; report explicitly limits lowest claim to actual finite search scope.
Report includes candidate structures/table downloads, actual method and geometry relationships, raw sources/hashes, generated script and unverified scientific coverage.
Operation, scientific checks, goal satisfaction, model explanation and deterministic report generation are separately reported. No QualifiedOutput may be inferred from a successful script.
